# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}/commits

Get commits for a pull request

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-232`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | int64 | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |
| verification | query | boolean | False |
| files | query | boolean | False |

## Response

**200** — CommitList

- **404** — PR not found or bad revision

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| medium | unbounded_queries | All commits are loaded into memory via ShowPrettyFormatLogToList before pagination is applied | Use git log with --skip and -n for server-side pagination |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P2] pagination**: Use git log --skip/--max-count for server-side pagination instead of loading all commits — *Impact: Reduce memory usage for large PRs from O(N) to O(page_size)*
